Mzee Matope’s cows produce one hundred and fifty four litres of milk in the morning. And one hundred and sixty three litres in the evening. How many litres of milk do the cows produce in a day? To do addition, we start by looking at the ones and add four to three, which gives us seven. Write Seven in ones place value .
